title: The Road to Dire Dawa
audience: DRAFT: my family and friends who have never been to Dire Dawa, plus Ethiopians abroad who miss home.
intent: DRAFT: by the end they should feel the warmth and colour of Dire Dawa and want to make the trip themselves.

style.visual_prefix: Warm cinematic travel photograph, golden-hour light, soft film grain, 35mm lens, natural colours of eastern Ethiopia, dusty ochre and teal accents.
style.negative: text, watermark, logo, distorted hands, extra fingers, cartoon, oversaturated
style.palette: ochre, sand, teal shutters, faded pastel colonial walls

characters.description: a young Ethiopian man in his twenties, short black hair, light beard, wearing a plain olive shirt and carrying a small brown backpack

en.style_prompt: Read this warmly and slowly, like a young man telling his family about a trip he loved:

am.style_prompt: Read this in Amharic, warmly and slowly, like a young man telling his family about a trip he loved:

music.prompt: Gentle Ethio-jazz inspired instrumental, krar and soft piano, slow tizita mode, warm and nostalgic, builds slightly then resolves

end_card.text:
Made with AI from a real trip.
Images, motion, music and voice were generated by AI models.

shots.purpose: Hook: the journey begins before dawn; sets the travel frame.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the traveller standing on a modern railway platform in Addis Ababa before dawn, a sleek electric train waiting, blue hour sky
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in towards the traveller, train lights flicker on

narration.en: I had heard about Dire Dawa my whole life. One morning, I finally went.
narration.am: ስለ ድሬዳዋ ሕይወቴን ሙሉ ሰምቼ ነበር። አንድ ጠዋት በመጨረሻ ሄድኩ።

shots.purpose: Show the distance and the change of landscape from highlands to lowlands.
shots.keyframe_prompt: view through a train window of the Ethiopian Rift Valley, dry acacia plains and distant mountains, the traveller's reflection faint in the glass
shots.motion_prompt: landscape slides past from right to left, steady

narration.en: The highlands fell away. The air grew warm, and the land turned gold.
narration.am: ደጋው ቀስ በቀስ ቀረ። አየሩ ሞቀ፣ መሬቱም ወርቃማ ሆነ።

shots.purpose: Arrival moment: the city reveals itself.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the old French-built Dire Dawa railway station building, pale yellow walls and arched windows, palm trees, bright morning light
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan right across the station facade

narration.en: Dire Dawa greeted me with heat, palm trees, and an old station full of stories.
narration.am: ድሬዳዋ በሙቀት፣ በዘንባባ ዛፎችና ታሪክ በሞላበት አሮጌ ጣቢያ ተቀበለችኝ።

shots.purpose: Texture of the old town: the place's character.
shots.keyframe_prompt: a quiet street in the Kezira old town of Dire Dawa, colonial-era houses with teal wooden shutters, bougainvillea, a bajaj parked by the wall
shots.motion_prompt: gentle dolly forward down the street, leaves moving in the breeze

narration.en: In Kezira, the streets are wide and quiet, and every wall seems to remember something.
narration.am: በከዚራ መንገዶቹ ሰፊና ጸጥ ያሉ ናቸው፤ እያንዳንዱ ግድግዳ የሆነ ነገር የሚያስታውስ ይመስላል።

shots.purpose: Energy and people: the living city.
shots.keyframe_prompt: a busy colourful open-air market in Dire Dawa, piles of spices, fruit and fabrics, vendors under umbrellas, warm afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: slow lateral track through the market crowd

narration.en: Then the market. Spices, fabric, voices in Amharic, Afaan Oromo and Somali, all at once.
narration.am: ከዚያ ገበያው። ቅመም፣ ጨርቅ፣ በአማርኛ፣ በኦሮምኛና በሶማሊኛ የሚጣሩ ድምፆች፣ ሁሉም በአንድ ጊዜ።

shots.purpose: Intimacy: a shared meal, the human warmth of the trip.
shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up of a shared meal on a small table in Dire Dawa, injera with spicy stew, glasses of sweet tea, hands reaching in
shots.motion_prompt: subtle slow zoom, steam rising from the food

narration.en: Strangers shared their food with me, as if I had always belonged there.
narration.am: የማላውቃቸው ሰዎች ምግባቸውን አካፈሉኝ፤ ሁልጊዜም የዚያ ሰው እንደሆንኩ።

shots.purpose: Pause and reflection: the quiet centre of the film.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the traveller sitting alone on the edge of the wide dry Dechatu riverbed at sunset, mountains in the distance, long shadows
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, the light fades warmer

narration.en: By the dry river, I understood why people who leave this city never stop talking about it.
narration.am: በደረቁ ወንዝ ዳር፣ ይህችን ከተማ የሚለቁ ሰዎች ስለሷ ማውራት የማያቆሙት ለምን እንደሆነ ገባኝ።

shots.purpose: The city at night: the last memory before leaving.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Dire Dawa at night, warm street lights, a small cafe with people talking outside, a bajaj passing with light trails
shots.motion_prompt: static camera, a bajaj passes through frame

narration.en: At night the city stays awake, laughing, talking, drinking tea under the lights.
narration.am: ማታ ከተማዋ አትተኛም፤ ትስቃለች፣ ታወራለች፣ በመብራቱ ስር ሻይ ትጠጣለች።

shots.purpose: Resolution: carrying the place home; invites the audience to go.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the traveller seen from behind boarding the train at Dire Dawa in morning light, looking back over his shoulder
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back as the traveller steps onto the train

narration.en: I left Dire Dawa, but it did not leave me. One day, go and see it for yourself.
narration.am: ድሬዳዋን ለቅቄ ሄድኩ፤ እሷ ግን አልለቀቀችኝም። አንድ ቀን ሂዱና ራሳችሁ እዩአት።
